reason: Make recovery depth, event impulse, boundary handling, and funding treatment executable before forward data is locked.

additional_data: funding-rate snapshots from the official funding-rate endpoint
changes.depth_measure: sum quote notional of the top five bid and ask levels whose prices are within 10 basis points of that snapshot mid
changes.recovery_observation: first book snapshot at or after window_end plus 5 seconds and no later than 2 seconds after that target
changes.recovery_rule: recovery depth must be at least 80% of the median depth over the preceding 60 seconds; the mid must stop making a new event-direction extreme during the recovery window
changes.event_impulse: negative pressure uses pre-event median mid minus the minimum mid from the event window; positive pressure uses the maximum mid from the event window minus the pre-event median mid
changes.boundary_policy: a missing book at either entry or exit boundary rejects the event
changes.funding_policy: an event crossing a funding settlement without an actual official funding-rate snapshot is excluded; predicted mark-price rates are never substituted
